name: Galaxy Grudge
summary:
Galaxy Grudge provides classic arena combat with smooth multiplayer, modern graphics and strong community involvement.

It's a fast-paced, free-to-play arena shooter inspired by the golden age of competitive FPS games. Experience fluid movement, inventive weapons, and intense multiplayer battles across a range of dynamic maps and modes. The game is based in a dystopian world where blood-sports are televised for a fanatic fanbase.

Join our development community to brainstorm ideas, provide feedback, participate in game tests and become a part of the next great Arena Shooter!

This game is currently in development. It contains one working Game Mode (Deathmatch), with Team Deathmatch and Capture The Flag coming soon. Ten powerful weapons, based on the classic Arena Shooter standards. (Pistol, Chainsaw, Sniper RIfle, Rocket Launcher, Blaster etc)

We currently have two full maps developed, with more coming soon.

Full settings menu with custom controls, graphics, player settings and sound settings.

Full multiplayer support with solid netcode for all game elements.

Highly dynamic movement with a range of unique movement abilities. Dodging, sliding, zero-G skating, and the ability to launch booster pads for bouncing players and projectiles.
